title.value: Ask HN: How do you reconcile metered usage with what your billing system invoiced?

story_text.value:
We bill per API call. Every month-end our controller exports usage from the warehouse and VLOOKUPs it against invoice lines. It takes four days and we still book an adjustment we can't explain.

What do you use? Is there a tool for usage reconciliation, or does everyone build it in dbt?
